data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $2.9m during 2015 (2014: release of $4.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $296.5m. During 2015 the syndicate reported a release of prior year reserves of $2.9m (reported in the Managing Agent's strategic report), indicating modest favourable development on prior years. No detailed gross prior-year movement note was found; the $2.9m figure is reported in the narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $2.9m during 2015 (2014: release of $4.6m).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2014 = 296.5). The prior year development figure ($2.9m release) is reported in the Managing Agent narrative; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table was found to confirm whether the $2.9m is gross or net of reinsurance. Prior-year movement therefore taken from narrative (confidence reduced). No per-line-of-business prior-year reserve movements disclosed.
